limitations: One simulated phantom and one selected human; no population/clinical claim
Manual DKT cortex is not tissue/skull/scalp truth; annotation/classifier lineage may be shared
Finite area-weighted surfel approximation, not exact continuous boundary distances
10 large-mesh cases do not receive full intersection/genus certification
Repair geometry does not independently validate anatomy or remap human vertex attributes
Off-grid solvers share isotropic spherical physics and solver-dependent scalp projection
Point-moment prior and nonnested 15-mm grid affect source-grid comparisons
Conditional participant BEM remains anatomically INDETERMINATE
20 paired noise draws do not estimate biological anatomical variability
